token_span: identical effective response-token span for every method

representations.mean_pool: all-token arithmetic mean; exactly DCT mode 0
representations.max_pool: coordinate-wise maximum over all effective response tokens
representations.mean_final_pool: concatenated all-token mean and final-token states; dimension matched to DCT q2
representations.mean_max_pool: concatenated all-token mean and coordinate-wise maximum; dimension matched to DCT q2
representations.final_max_pool: concatenated final-token state and coordinate-wise maximum; dimension matched to DCT q2
representations.learned_temporal_h1: one learned global linear mixture of modes 0..7; output dimension matched to single pooling baselines
representations.learned_temporal_h2: two learned global linear mixtures of modes 0..7; output dimension matched to DCT q2

fit_scope: all standardization, temporal weights, and linear source heads are fitted on outer-training prompts only
